name: Bad Heilbrunn (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Bad Heilbrunn (a white fountain on red above Bavarian lozenges).
history: The arms were granted by the Bavarian State Ministry of the Interior on 13 April 1958; the banner carries them on white and red.

features.role: Bad Heilbrunn arms — fountain over lozenges
